en_title: LEGO and Netflix Team Up for 37,000-Piece Kpop Demon Hunters Build
cn_title: 乐高近3.7万块积木搭出巨型呆虎
subtitle: 像人形3D打印机
opus_summary: 乐高与网飞委托设计师用近3.7万块积木，搭建《KPOP：猎魔女团》巨型呆虎。作品断续制作约两个半月，现于荷兰乐高世界展出，展期至10月21日，展后去向尚未公布。

paragraphs.en: LEGO designer Björn Ramant has revealed a giant Derpy Tiger build based on the animated Netflix hit Kpop Demon Hunters .
paragraphs.cn: 乐高设计师Björn Ramant公开了一座巨型呆虎积木模型，原型来自网飞热门动画电影《KPOP：猎魔女团》。

paragraphs.en: Ramant shared the full build, which was commissioned by Netflix and LEGO, on his personal LinkedIn and Instagram . A 90-second timelapse shows the entire building process, from tail to ears, with Ramant reportedly using almost 37,000 total plastic bricks in the final product.
paragraphs.cn: Ramant在个人领英和Instagram账号上分享了这件由网飞与乐高委托制作的完整作品。一段90秒的延时视频记录了从尾巴到耳朵的整个搭建过程，据称成品共用了近37,000块塑料积木。

paragraphs.en: The giant LEGO Derpy Tiger is now on display at LEGO World 2026 while LEGO's official (and much smaller) Kpop Demon Hunters set happens to be on sale at Amazon .
paragraphs.cn: 这座巨型乐高呆虎目前正在2026乐高世界展出，而乐高官方推出的《KPOP：猎魔女团》套装恰好也在亚马逊促销，不过套装的尺寸要小得多。

paragraphs.en: While Ramant's post doesn’t reveal exact dimensions, the completed build appears almost as tall as the designer himself. Answering questions in the comments, Ramant explains that the full build took about two and a half months of on and off work. He used almost 37,000 bricks, though clarifies he wasn’t paying for each one - the work was a commission from the LEGO Group and Netflix.
paragraphs.cn: Ramant没有在帖子中透露模型的具体尺寸，但成品看起来几乎和他本人一样高。他在评论区回答提问时解释说，整件作品断断续续搭了约两个半月，共用了近37,000块积木。不过他也澄清，积木并不需要自己逐块掏钱购买——这是乐高集团与网飞委托他制作的作品。

paragraphs.en: In the video, Ramant is shown starting with the tail and using four steel rods to support the rest of the build. He builds up layers of the tiger demon’s blue and black fur, finishing with his slightly haunting yellow eyes. Commenters were quick to compare the full timelapse to watching a human 3D printer.
paragraphs.cn: 视频中，Ramant从尾巴开始搭建，并用四根钢杆支撑模型的其余部分。他逐层搭出这只虎妖蓝黑相间的皮毛，最后完成那双略显瘆人的黄色眼睛。评论区很快就有人表示，看完整段延时视频，简直就像在看一台人形3D打印机工作。

paragraphs.en: The full build is currently on display at LEGO World 2026 , taking place at the Jaarbeurs convention center in Utrecht, Netherlands, though October 21. An additional post on Ramant's Instagram shows the build in action, but there’s no word on what will happen to the giant Derpy after the event concludes.
paragraphs.cn: 这件完整作品目前正在2026乐高世界展出。展会在荷兰乌得勒支的Jaarbeurs会展中心举行，持续至10月21日。Ramant还在Instagram的另一则帖子中展示了模型的现场模样，但这只巨型呆虎在活动结束后将何去何从，目前尚无消息。

paragraphs.en: Wes Talbott, a Master Designer who worked on the original LEGO Derpy Tiger set, discussed how the approached capturing Derpy’s chaotic charm in an interview with LEGO . The hardest part? Those funky eyes, with Talbott saying “It took a lot of testing to get both the shape and the angle right.” Ramant seems to have replicated the original team’s eye design in his mega build.
paragraphs.cn: 曾参与原版乐高呆虎套装设计的首席设计师Wes Talbott，在接受乐高采访时谈到了团队如何还原呆虎的混乱魅力。最难的部分是什么？就是那双古怪的眼睛。Talbott说：「我们做了大量测试，才把形状和角度都调整到位。」Ramant似乎在自己的巨型模型中复现了原设计团队的眼睛造型。

paragraphs.en: As of now, Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird is the only official LEGO set based on KPop Demon Hunters. It’s hard to believe that LEGO hasn’t dropped any kind of HUNTR/X or Saja Boys minifigures, but we’ll likely see more collaborations in the ( very long ) lead-up to the Kpop Demon Hunters sequel .
paragraphs.cn: 截至目前，呆虎与Sussie鸟仍是唯一一款《KPOP：猎魔女团》官方乐高套装。很难相信，乐高居然还没推出过任何HUNTR/X或Saja Boys人仔，不过在等待《KPOP：猎魔女团》续集上映的这段（非常漫长的）时间里，我们很可能会看到更多联动。
